start_here: Say to your AI: "Which of my workflows fire for this: 'A finding: most small teams never write their plan down.'?" It splits the words into parts, tags each (kinds finding, subjects planning), runs tool:choose-the-workflows-that-fire with those parts and tells you each workflow whose own conditions keep a part, the ones that have no condition yet and the parts nothing kept.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours to fill: it reads your own workflow rows (record:workflow-recipe and the older workflow-recipe) and the Workshop's installed recipes, and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Give a workflow of yours its conditions: on its row (records:write at @own-records, record:workflow-recipe:<slug>) set fires_when to a JSON list of {label, condition: {fields, tree}, made_by, state: "On"}; the condition is what tool:filter-rows-by-rules takes. For a workflow you only installed from the Workshop, a row with only {recipe, fires_when} adds yours.
2. Split what arrived into parts and give each part its typed fields (kinds, subjects, people, niches, own_words, or whatever your conditions read).
3. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:choose-the-workflows-that-fire and input {parts}.

4. Read chosen (workflow, part, the condition that kept it), unfinished (conditions to fix), unconditioned (workflows to give a condition) and unmatched_parts; start each chosen workflow with tool:start-a-recipe-run.

worked_examples.title: A research finding reaches the workflow whose condition keeps findings
worked_examples.ask: Which of my workflows fire for: 'A finding: most small teams never write their plan down.'?

parts.words: A finding: most small teams never write their plan down.

worked_examples.given: One part tagged finding and claim with the subject planning, on an account whose own row record:workflow-recipe:research-to-plan carries the condition "a research finding arrives" (kinds has any of finding).
worked_examples.hands_back: chosen holds workflow:research-to-plan (from own, condition "a research finding arrives") and workflow:research-what-everyone-says (from catalog, condition "a seed makes a claim or names a subject"), both for part 0; unconditioned lists the workflows with no condition yet; unmatched_parts is empty.
